title: Normalize recoverable leaf finding ranges
summary: Review findings whose primary line lies inside location.range but differs from start-line are no longer rejected. A deep-copied candidate drops the optional range, keeps the raw output unchanged, and must pass the existing strict acceptance gate. All other invalid or ambiguous leaves still fail.
key_points: Optional location.range is removed when start-line <= line <= end-line, start-line differs from line, and no suggested-code is present
Raw Task output is kept unchanged as the audit payload; normalization is recorded separately in private telemetry
The normalized candidate must pass the full existing strict acceptance gate before rollup
Reversed or out-of-bounds ranges, missing fields, and bad JSON or paths still fail the whole leaf
New Test-ReviewContract.ps1 regression test keeps the DO, coordinator and standalone runner docs aligned
